prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence for specific kinds of change is still thin, as no category has at least 2 tests yet.
Predictions have generally been too high compared to noise-corrected results (Rounds 1 and 3), though Round 4 was slightly underestimated.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +2.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 64.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Account Creation Order: Move the sign-in step after pet selection and adoption certificate creation so users experience pet creation before creating an account. (why: Sign in drops 27.1% of users early with a high mean time (567s). Allowing users to pick/create their pet first builds engagement before asking for authentication.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Preview Screen: Add an explicit interactive preview screen showing desktop hotkeys, dragging, and pet hiding controls right before completing onboarding. (why: Support emails show post-onboarding confusion around controlling, hiding, or talking to pets, contributing to a final step drop-off of 35.2%.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Grid Pet Selection Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a responsive grid view with visual trait badges for quick decision-making. (why: Adoption has a low 64.8% conversion rate and takes a median 89s / mean 1017s, indicating friction during selection.)
3: [choose_path, new_flow] Pet Personality Matcher Quiz: Insert a 2-question personality quiz flow right before path selection to help users choose between preset or custom pets. (why: 23.8% of users abandon at choose_path and take a mean time of 514s, suggesting uncertainty about which adoption path suits them best.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Reminder Hint: Display a clear account persistence notice on the sign-in screen informing users to use the same provider to retain pets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets being missing or reset after signing in again with a different login method.)
5: [home, wait_info] Wait Screen Progress and Estimate: Enable visual time estimation and background notification toggles while the pet is being prepared on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s (median 201s), causing user drop-off when generation feels stalled.)
6: [choose_path, incentive] Quick Start Time Guarantee Copy: Update the story screen copy to highlight that adoption takes less than 2 minutes. (why: High drop-off on initial path choice (23.8%) paired with long mean duration suggests users fear a lengthy setup process.)
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Quick Controls Copy Refinement: Rewrite the home intro headline and body to explicitly explain desktop interaction controls like dragging, clicking, and context menus. (why: Finish step retention is only 64.8% (overall completion 19.0%) and support reports multiple inquiries regarding desktop pet controls.)
8: [adoption, notification] Photo Upload Progress Estimate & Notification: Add an estimated completion timer and desktop ready notification switch to the photo upload screen. (why: Making custom pets often stalls or takes long (mean adoption time 1017s), leading to 35.2% drop-off in adoption and failed generation reports.)
9: [choose_path, layout] Two-Column Path Selection Layout: Switch the choose_path screen layout to a side-by-side two-column view comparing preset vs custom creation. (why: Selecting a path currently takes a mean of 514s, indicating confusion between the options available.)
